@copilot 感觉问题解决了一半，原来重复三遍，现在重复两遍

> @copilot 感觉问题解决了一半，原来重复三遍，现在重复两遍

Found and fixed the remaining duplicate. There were actually **two independent double-fetch issues**:

1. *(Previous commit, 92c02b8)* `ObjectCalendarRenderer` was stripping `data`/`loading`, so `ObjectCalendar` always ran its own `dataSource.find()`.

2. *(New commit, 0f09003)* `ObjectView.fetchData` had `objectSchema` in its effect deps. When `fetchObjectSchema` completed and set `objectSchema` state, React re-ran `fetchData` a second time — two separate `dataSource.find()` calls per view activation. Both results were passed down to the calendar as `data`, producing the remaining 2× duplication.

Fix: replaced `objectSchema` in the effect with an `objectSchemaRef` (updated during render, same pattern already used inside `ObjectCalendar`) so `fetchData` runs exactly once per meaningful change. Also added `.value` extraction support (OData format) that was missing from ObjectView's manual record extraction.
